answer: Hardware TEE attestation binds each claim to a measured enclave. The quote is checked against a known-good build, and a mismatch slashes the bond. No identity audits its own recruit, so a sponsor cannot clear its own shells. The raven on the wire is the quote log, and it does not forget. A farm needs 1,000 valid quotes from 1,000 real enclaves, and every one sits on the horizon as a fixed cost before any payout. The inlet closes there.
